name: clinica-tanah
description: Clínica Tanah — Medical-grade CRM for São Paulo, Brasil. LGPD-compliant, WhatsApp bot, inventory, accounting, payroll. Trilingual PT/ES/EN.

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && rm -rf ../backend/public && mkdir -p ../backend/public && cp -r dist/* ../backend/public/
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
